**Finding: Compliant** (rule MFN)

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation running against Mortgage Logic.com. The only MFN-type language, in § 5/6 (p0047), operates in our favour — TrueLink warrants that Hosting Services rates "will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party," plus a one-year price freeze. Per the rule's detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is welcome and is not redlined. Targeted searches for the usual triggers (most favored, no less favorable, matching third-party offers, exclusivity) surfaced nothing binding the Client. No redline proposed.
